edition.en: Blake’s own text in the Pickering Manuscript, as transcribed on Wikisource, with his spelling and near-absence of punctuation
edition.zh: 据维基文库所录布莱克“皮克林手稿”原文，保留其拼写和几乎不加标点的写法

basis.en: Written about 1803 and first printed in 1863; the author died in 1827.
basis.zh: 约 1803 年写成，1863 年首次付印；作者卒于 1827 年。

note.en: Blake left this poem in a notebook, the Pickering Manuscript; it was first printed in 1863, long after his death. Its opening quatrain is among the most quoted lines in English, and the rest is a long run of couplets, each a small law that ties a hurt creature to the whole of heaven. Read slowly; the lack of punctuation is Blake’s, and the pauses are left to you.
note.zh: 布莱克把这首诗留在一本笔记里，即“皮克林手稿”；它在他去世很久以后的 1863 年才首次印出。开头四行是英语里被引用最多的诗句之一，其后是一长串对句，每一句都是一条小小的定律，把一只受伤的生灵与整个天国连在一起。请慢慢读；不加标点是布莱克自己的写法，停顿留给了你。

excerpt.orig:
To see a World in a Grain of Sand
And a Heaven in a Wild Flower
Hold Infinity in the palm of your hand
And Eternity in an hour
excerpt.en:

excerpt.zh:
从一粒沙看见一个世界
